page.overview:
Who is Fitzgerald?

Admiral Fitzgerald was a 23rd century Starfleet flag officer.

In 2268, Fitzgerald ordered first officer, Spock, not to beam down to the surface of the planet in search of the missing Captain James T. Kirk.

He noted that, despite sympathizing deeply with the situation, Starfleet simply could not override Federation directives in such a matter as doing so would only provoke war. ()
